news.title: Response to Ariel and Hasid’s Letter
news.summary_en: This article defends the importance of studying LLMs for alcohol misuse support outside clinical settings, noting most affected individuals never engage with formal care and use digital tools independently.

news.title: Verified Machine Learning Infrastructure: Formal Methods for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence Deployment
news.summary_en: The authors determine whether formal methods—using mathematical techniques to reason about software behavior and, potentially, show that systems behave as specified—could meaningfully secure the infrastructure on which artificial intelligence runs.

news.title: AI Chatbot Use and Disclosure for Mental Health Among US Adolescents and Young Adults
news.summary_en: The objective of this paper is to assess the prevalence, frequency, perceived helpfulness, and disclosure of AI chatbot use for mental health advice among US adolescents and young adults in 2025.
